title: Edges into the Accepting Vertex
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over bits, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $s,u$ be natural numbers. There is an edge from vertex $u+2$ to vertex $1$ at radius $s$ exactly when the encoding of $x$, configuration code $u$, and radius $s$ belongs to the machine's accepting-configuration language.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over bits
